citation.verbatim: The Amendment became effective at 4:01 p.m. Eastern Time on June 7, 2024. Exhibit 3.1: At the Effective Time, each share of Common Stock issued as of immediately prior to the Effective Time shall be automatically subdivided and reclassified into ten (10) validly issued, fully paid and non-assessable shares of Common Stock. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on June 10, 2024.

changes.what: NVDA basket quantity per creation unit

changes.where: MEGA custody position verification ledger as of 2024-06-07

changes.what: NVDA June gross dividend cash projection

D1.decision: The June 7 effectiveness filing confirms the mandatory ten-for-one split was effected. Apply it to the 18,000-share June 6 record-date position, update today's PCF to 1,800 shares per creation unit, and confirm 180,000 post-split shares. Separately, use the May 22 dividend declaration and projected June 11 record-date position to book the $1,800 gross dividend. No election exists. Hold only the withholding adjustment and net dividend figure pending missing tax/withholding documentation.

actions.action: update PCF NVDA quantity per creation unit to 1,800
escalate and hold: Determine and book the withholding adjustment / net June dividend cash
actions.note: missing document: MEGA account tax/withholding profile and applicable withholding-rate documentation for the NVDA June dividend

probe.label: NOT_DETERMINABLE
probe.derivation: The May 22 declaration provides a $0.01 post-split dividend rate, and the projected 2024-06-11 record-date position is 180,000 shares, so gross cash is 180,000 × 0.01 = 1,800. Net cash is not determinable because the store lacks the MEGA account tax/withholding profile and applicable withholding-rate documentation for the NVDA June dividend. The missing documentation was escalated, and only the withholding adjustment/net figure is held.
